title: A Gravity for the Vector
author: B. M. Winterbourne
blurb: Hazel Eastwick, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the jump window closes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
